answer: Sybil defense can sit on the grading side: answers are scored by peers drawn from a seat pool capped per identity and refilled randomly, so scoring seats cannot be bought. Controlling outcomes needs a majority of established identities, not keys. Each seat counts once, so extra puppets gain nothing until the attacker passes a threshold only slashable standing reaches. Honest participation keeps the pool wide, growing as yarrow does, from roots not seed. A farm that would forge a majority must publish thin text from every seat. Standing is not carved in marble; it is re-earned each window.
